title: QUIC RFC 9000 ACK Frame Focused Proof Work Item
summary: Decompose RFC 9000 S19P3 ACK frame proof into focused requirement-home tests and canonical trace evidence.
planned_changes:
- Add S19P3 ACK-frame test support for exact ACK byte construction, varint boundary cases, sender acknowledgment state, and ACK range math.
- Add focused positive, negative, and edge requirement-home tests for ACK field parsing, ACK range count and layout, packet-number-space-qualified ACK processing, acknowledged-packet persistence, Version Negotiation and Retry exclusion, and ECN counter feedback.
- Update canonical S19P3 xrefs and generated coverage triage.
verification_plan: Run the focused S19P3 requirement-home filter, run supporting ACK frame codec/fuzz tests, regenerate QUIC requirement coverage triage, run a Release build, and validate SpecTrace JSON.
out_of_scope: Completing other RFC 9000 S19 frame families.
Changing packet-level close emission policy for every malformed ACK frame.
Claiming full ECN validation policy beyond the validated CE feedback congestion seam.
Changing public QUIC APIs or interop support boundaries.
completion_notes: Completed as focused proof decomposition over existing ACK parser, formatter, ACK-generation state, sender flow controller, packet-number-space classifier, and ECN congestion feedback behavior.
